svg.title: franka-real checks the Franka FR3 before an AI agent can run a task
svg.desc: The arm is left stretched out near a singularity. An AI agent asks to run a task; franka-real checks the robot, two checks fail, the request is refused and nothing moves. The operator returns the arm to Ready Home. The same request passes every check and the arm runs the approved pick-and-place task.
svg.text: At Ready Home5 mm · 1° · 1° per joint

g.text: franka_real_task_status → finished · back at Ready Home
The arm was left stretched out, close to a singularity
An AI agent asks to run a task. franka-real checks the robot first
Refused, so nothing moves. The singularity is read from the robot's log
The operator returns the arm to Ready Home
Same request from Ready Home: every check passes
The arm runs the approved task and returns to Ready Home
